adaptation: Phillips and conjugate time evolution adapted to existing Native C2 buffers. Explicit modular negative indices replace out-of-range textureLoad in upstream. Vector Fourier multipliers corrected to independent complex components; Nyquist derivative zero. FFT butterfly is a new C2 buffer/layout adapter of standard radix2 complex math, reviewed against the fixed upstream. No BabylonJS runtime, shaded materials, assets or external FFT precomputation copied.
